what: A player connects the wallet of the browser, sees the Chog Genesis that wallet holds, picks one, signs in, plays, and the career of that Genesis is recorded. A player without a Genesis plays a recruit.
method: Headless Chrome, muted, touch emulation, through the LAN address (http://192.168.1.85). The browser wallet is replaced by a stand-in injected before the page loads (tools/unity/qualify_webgl.mjs). The game services are the local stand-in (node server/src/local.js) behind the WebGL test server. No real wallet was used.

ownership_read.how: One Multicall3 call of ownerOf for the 1,969 tokens on Monad mainnet (chain 143), about 1.2 s on rpc.monad.xyz, reused 20 s.
checked: 0x80fb079237af2a634ba9b95263ba0bd53d20cd64 holds [1795] (block 111875227), as in the owner scan recorded the same morning

signed_path.why_a_test_key: No private key of a real holder is available here and none must be. The stand-in wallet used the private key published in the web3.js documentation, a public test value, and really signed. A second copy of the services (port 8091, its own data folder) was started with --pretend-holder so that this address is answered as the holder of tokens 408, 1795 and 3; the real services answer that it holds nothing.

later_checks_same_day.after_disconnect: Leaving a session with the DISCONNECT button of the in-match menu brings back the main menu with the panel, the sixteen Genesis and the choice intact (build 20261009T131346574Z).
later_checks_same_day.after_reload: Connect, tap the third Genesis, sign in, then load the page again in the same browser (build 20261009T133145106Z, the one on port 8083): the wallet is recognised without a tap, the third Genesis is still chosen, and the career line shows in place of the sign-in button (research/evidence/genesis-wallet-after-reload-headless-2026-10-09.png). The stand-in wallet remembers within the browser session that it shared its address, as a wallet does; the game's part is what it wrote to the browser's storage.
later_checks_same_day.third_match: The signed path again on build 20261009T131346574Z: 'credited token 408 : 3 matches, 1 wins'.
later_checks_same_day.resend: A result whose request fails or gets a 5xx answer is sent again, three attempts in all; only the rule that decides it is tested (view test), no failing service was simulated in a browser.

open_in_metamask.what: On a phone browser without a wallet, over HTTPS, the menu panel offers OPEN IN METAMASK, which leaves for https://link.metamask.io/dapp/<address>, the format given in MetaMask's documentation (docs.metamask.io, 'Use deeplinks', read 2026-10-09).
open_in_metamask.method: A throwaway local HTTPS host with a self-signed certificate (port 8443), headless Chrome with a phone user agent and touch emulation, no wallet injected, certificate errors ignored for this run only.
open_in_metamask.seen: The button shows (research/evidence/genesis-open-in-metamask-headless-2026-10-09.png). After the tap the browser requested the link; link.metamask.io answered a phone user agent with HTTP 307 to 'intent://open?...;scheme=metamask;package=io.metamask', the Android intent for the MetaMask app. The test browser cannot follow an intent (request failed: ERR_ABORTED intent://open...), so the page stayed.
open_in_metamask.not_done: A real phone with the MetaMask app. Whether the app then opens the game address, with or without its path, is not known from this test. iOS was not simulated.

tests.services: 20 tests (node --test): owner scan encoding and decoding, cache and fresh read before a credit, endpoint fallback, EIP-55 vectors, the personal_sign example of the web3.js documentation (an independent implementation), challenge and session forgery cases, career rules (once per match, 60 s spacing, badges, confirmation by another address), the HTTP flow including a holder who sells the token.
tests.simulation: 22 Quantum tests, including 'a player without a Genesis is a recruit with less health, in a Genesis match only'.
tests.view_logic: 13 tests outside Unity: choice among the tokens held, services address, kept session, match name, career text.

limits: No real wallet was tried: MetaMask, Rabby or Backpack, as an extension or in their phone browser, may behave differently from the stand-in (prompts, chain selection, personal_sign encoding).
The match accepts any declared token: ownership is checked by the services when they credit, not at the door of the match. The '?token=' test entry still lets anyone play any Genesis.
A result is what the player's own page reports. A holder who writes requests by hand can invent results for their own Genesis. 'confirmed' needs a second signed-in player and stayed 0 here.
A smart-contract wallet (ERC-1271) cannot sign in.
The services run on this Mac only; nothing is deployed, and the careers live in one JSON file.
